# You should build libzmq under MacOS X as following

1. checkout the repository

git clone https://github.com/zeromq/libzmq.git


2. Configure and build 

export MACOSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET=12.4
cd libzmq
./autogen.sh
./configure
make
sudo make install

the PKG has been built this way on arm6 and  x86_64 architectures and then
the binary files have been merged together with the lipo tool and put into a nice
package. The files install into /usr/local/
